fields.acceptance: The workflow-new testscript shows workflow new writing the skeleton (exit 0) with no make test and the examples present, workflow check on it exiting 0 with a warning naming the placeholder, and no such warning once the placeholder is replaced.
fields.statement: rhiza workflow new without --from writes a skeleton whose test command is a placeholder, with comments on every field and example commands for Go, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust, plus a commented cleanup step and environment example; the placeholder is a workflow check warning, which never makes the workflow invalid, so workflow new still validates and writes the skeleton, and workflow check warns about it until it is replaced.
